content.text: Clause located. Section 12.3 expressly confirms the absence of any no-hire/non-solicit restriction on Customer, and no non-solicitation language appears anywhere in the document.

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce" and "personnel" across the Agreement return no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Customer; §30 (General), §16 (Confidentiality) and §12 (Customer Responsibilities) contain none. To the contrary, §12.3 affirmatively preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. That matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) and is favourable to us, so no redline is warranted. Note that §12.4 restricts Vendor only (competing analytics products), which benefits our party and is outside this rule.
